title: Synthetic Data Governance for Regulated Healthcare (HIPAA/HITRUST + Enterprise Data Governance)
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (synthetic clinical data / AI test enablement; data-engineering/simulation/governance work, privacy care).

Synthetic-data & digital-twin tools (e.g. Synthea, commercial platforms) and AI/model frameworks integrated at the pattern level; vendor internals cited or deferred, never invented. Regulatory/legal interpretation (HIPAA/HITRUST de-identification, IRB/privacy sign-off, disclosure risk) deferred to privacy/compliance/legal. Never real PHI in a shared harness/twin/AI test env. Automation is Python.
hook: Govern synthetic data like the regulated asset it is
problem: Even synthetic data needs governance in a regulated healthcare enterprise — lineage, approval, access, and alignment to HIPAA/HITRUST and enterprise data-governance standards. This solution establishes synthetic data governance: the policies, catalog/lineage, approval workflow, access model, and controls that make synthetic and test data managed, auditable, and aligned to regulated-data constraints — so the capability scales without becoming a shadow risk.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the synthetic-data governance model: policy, catalog/lineage, classification, approval, access, and how it aligns to HIPAA/HITRUST + enterprise data governance.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (governance/compliance stakeholders, catalog tooling, classification scheme, policy).

Implementation Guide — define the governance policy + roles, stand up catalog/lineage and classification for synthetic/test assets, wire approval + access controls, and validate against the standards, pilot-first.

5 Python tools — assessment/profiling, generation or scenario execution, a fidelity/coverage report, a privacy/validation check, and a scope/config helper — authentic to synthetic-data engineering (safe by default; no real PHI written to shared locations).
Testing/validation gates (assets cataloged, approvals enforced, aligned) plus Best Practices; regulatory interpretation deferred to compliance/legal.
short: Establish synthetic data governance for regulated healthcare — policy, catalog/lineage, approval, access, aligned to HIPAA/HITRUST + enterprise data governance — so the capability scales without shadow risk. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
